title: Nrf2 activation by pyrroloquinoline quinone inhibits natural aging-related intervertebral disk degeneration in mice.
authors: Xue, Qi; Li, Jie; Qin, Ran; Li, Mingying; Li, Yiping; Zhang, Jing; Wang, Rong; Goltzman, David; Miao, Dengshun; Yang, Renlei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PQQ通过Keap1-Nrf2-Wnt5a轴抑制椎间盘退变，虽涉及Nrf2-DNA启动子结合和分子对接，但核心是衰老与氧化应激的生物学机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合预测，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Age-related intervertebral disk degeneration (IVDD) involves increased oxidative damage, cellular senescence, and matrix degradation. Pyrroloquinoline quinone (PQQ) is a water-soluble vitamin-like compound with strong anti-oxidant capacity. The goal of this study was to determine whether PQQ can prevent aging-related IVDD, and the underlying mechanism. Here, we found that dietary PQQ supplementation for 12 months alleviated IVDD phenotypes in aged mice, including increased disk height index and reduced histological scores and cell loss, without toxicity. Mechanistically, PQQ inhibited oxidative stress, cellular senescence, and senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) in the nucleus pulposus and annulus fibrosus of aged mice. Similarly, PQQ protected against interleukin-1beta-induced matrix degradation, reactive oxygen species accumulation, and senescence in human nucleus pulposus cells (NPCs) in vitro. Molecular docking predicted and biochemical assays validated that PQQ interacts with specific residues to dissociate the Keap1-Nrf2 complex, thereby increasing nuclear Nrf2 translocation and activation of Nrf2-ARE signaling. RNA sequencing and luciferase assays revealed Nrf2 can transcriptionally upregulate Wnt5a by binding to its promoter, while Wnt5a knockdown prevented PQQ inhibition of matrix metalloproteinase-13 in NPCs. Notably, PQQ supplementation failed to alleviate aging-associated IVDD phenotypes and oxidative stress in aged Nrf2 knockout mice, indicating Nrf2 is indispensable for PQQ bioactivities. Collectively, this study demonstrates Nrf2 activation by PQQ inhibits aging-induced IVDD by attenuating cellular senescence and matrix degradation. This study clarifies Keap1-Nrf2-Wnt5a axis as the novel signaling underlying the protective effects of PQQ against aging-related IVDD, and provides evidence for PQQ as a potential agent for clinical prevention and treatment of natural aging-induced IVDD.
abstract_zh: 年龄相关的椎间盘退变（IVDD）涉及氧化损伤增加、细胞衰老和基质降解。吡咯喹啉醌（PQQ）是一种水溶性维生素样化合物，具有强抗氧化能力。本研究旨在确定PQQ是否能预防衰老相关的IVDD及其潜在机制。本研究发现，饮食补充PQQ 12个月可缓解老年小鼠的IVDD表型，包括椎间盘高度指数增加、组织学评分降低和细胞损失减少，且无毒性。机制上，PQQ抑制了老年小鼠髓核和纤维环中的氧化应激、细胞衰老及衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）。同样，PQQ在体外保护人髓核细胞（NPCs）免受白细胞介素-1β诱导的基质降解、活性氧积累和衰老。分子对接预测和生化实验验证表明，PQQ与特定残基相互作用，解离Keap1-Nrf2复合物，从而增加核内Nrf2转位并激活Nrf2-ARE信号通路。RNA测序和荧光素酶实验揭示，Nrf2可通过结合其启动子转录上调Wnt5a，而Wnt5a敲低阻止了PQQ对NPCs中基质金属蛋白酶-13的抑制作用。值得注意的是，在老年Nrf2敲除小鼠中，PQQ补充未能缓解衰老相关的IVDD表型和氧化应激，表明Nrf2对PQQ生物活性不可或缺。综上，本研究证明PQQ通过激活Nrf2抑制衰老诱导的IVDD，其机制涉及减轻细胞衰老和基质降解。本研究阐明了Keap1-Nrf2-Wnt5a轴作为PQQ对抗衰老相关IVDD保护作用的新信号通路，并为PQQ作为临床预防和治疗自然衰老诱导IVDD的潜在药物提供了证据。
